optimizedContext.value:
# SDK Composition

## Rules

- Package: `packages/sdk/`; workspace `sdk`; runtime deps only `@specd/core`, `@specd/code-graph`; MUST NOT depend on `@specd/cli`, `@specd/mcp`, plugins.
- Hexagonal layout: `src/composition/` (`openSpecdHost`, `createSdkContext`, `withOpenGraphProvider`); `src/orchestration/` (`buildProjectStatusSnapshot`, `runIndexProjectGraph`, `buildImplementationReview`); `src/presentation/` pure `changeContextToMarkdown` / `projectContextToMarkdown`; `src/shared/` unexported internal helpers; `src/index.ts` public barrel only.
- No domain entities, application ports, infrastructure adapters. Presentation helpers: no I/O, MAY export.
- `package.json` exports: `.` -> `src/index.ts`; `./ports` -> `@specd/core/ports`; `./extensions` -> `@specd/core/extensions`.
- `src/index.ts` explicit exports only: composition APIs/types; orchestration APIs/I/O types (`buildImplementationReview`, reference, coverage, health types); `changeContextToMarkdown`, `projectContextToMarkdown`, `ChangeContextToMarkdownOptions`; curated `@specd/core` public APIs; curated `@specd/code-graph` public APIs; `SDK_VERSION`, `codeGraphVersion`, `getCodeGraphVersion`.
- Core surface MUST track revised `kernel.specs`: bootstrap, `Kernel`, kernel-equivalent `createX` factories, repository factories, kernel use-case I/O, entities, errors, `MaterializeSpecMetadata`, `GetSpecMetadata`, `RegenerateSpecMetadata`, `InitializePersistedSpecState`, persisted schema inspect/reassign, persisted dependency/implementation/optimization use cases, corresponding `create*` factories.
- MUST NOT wildcard-export `@specd/core`; export infrastructure, internal composition, or dependency `./internal` symbols; export `SaveSpecMetadata`, `UpdateSpecMetadata`, `InvalidateSpecMetadata`, their `createSaveSpecMetadata` / `createUpdateSpecMetadata` / `createInvalidateSpecMetadata`, or `PersistSpecMetadata`.
- Host-adapter re-exports from `@specd/code-graph` `.`: `acquireGraphIndexLock`, `assertGraphIndexUnlocked`, `createGetGraphHealth`, `GetGraphHealthInput`, `GetGraphHealthResult`, `IndexResult`, `HotspotResult`, `ImpactResult`, `FileImpactResult`, `codeGraphVersion`, `getCodeGraphVersion`, `GraphSpecNotFoundError`, `SymbolKind`, `SearchOptions`, `HotspotOptions`, `RiskLevel`, `normalizeFileSelectorPath`, `createBootstrapGraphConfig`, `isGraphStale`, `detectFingerprintMismatch`, `parseFingerprintMap`, `buildProjectGraphConfig`.
- Delivery hosts using core+code-graph MUST depend only on `@specd/sdk` and import host symbols there. Core-only `plugin-*` / `skills` MAY depend directly on `@specd/core`.
- Storage implementers MAY use `@specd/core/ports` or `@specd/sdk/ports`; registration types via `@specd/core/extensions` or `@specd/sdk/extensions`.
- Export `SDK_VERSION` string matching `package.json` version.

## Constraints

- Thin composition/orchestration package; no infrastructure or host bootstrap duplication.
- `src/shared/` never re-exported.
